typeText:
∀ (P : List.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Instr) (f : Nat) (c : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cfg) (n t : Nat)
  (c' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cfg) (n' t' : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.runFuel P f c n t)
      (Prod.mk.{0, 0} c' (Prod.mk.{0, 0} n' (Prod.mk.{0, 0} t' Bool.true))) →
    ∃ n₀ t₀,
      And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Run P c c' n₀ t₀)
        (And (Eq.{1} n' (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n n₀))
          (And (Eq.{1} t' (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t t₀)) (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Halted P c')))

source.code:
theorem runFuel_sound (P : List Instr) : ∀ (f : ℕ) (c : Cfg) (n t : ℕ) (c' : Cfg) (n' t' : ℕ),
    runFuel P f c n t = (c', n', t', true) →
      ∃ n₀ t₀, Run P c c' n₀ t₀ ∧ n' = n + n₀ ∧ t' = t + t₀ ∧ Halted P c'
  | 0, c, n, t, c', n', t', h => by simp [runFuel] at h
  | f + 1, c, n, t, c', n', t', h => by
      simp only [runFuel] at h
      cases hs : step P c with
      | none =>
          rw [hs] at h
          simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
          obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, _⟩ := h
          exact ⟨0, 0, Run.refl c, by omega, by omega, hs⟩
      | some ck =>
          obtain ⟨c₁, k⟩ := ck
          rw [hs] at h
          obtain ⟨n₀, t₀, r, hn, ht, hh⟩ := runFuel_sound P f c₁ (n + 1) (t + k) c' n' t' h
          exact ⟨n₀ + 1, k + t₀, Run.step hs r, by omega, by omega, hh⟩
